record.oneLiner: An armoured titanosaur sauropod of Late Cretaceous Argentina.
record.description: Saltasaurus was a small, stocky titanosaurian sauropod of Late Cretaceous Argentina with a short neck and stubby limbs. It was the first sauropod known to bear bony armour — small plates (osteoderms) embedded in its skin.

notableFacts.text: The first sauropod known to have bony armour plates in its skin.
Small and stocky, with a short neck and stubby limbs.
